Subject: Close sprint: readiness checklist, stage updates & commit logistics

Team —

We have 48 hours before quarter cutoff. Quick, practical runbook below so finance has a clean commit rollup by EOD Thu. Please reply inline with your stage-by-stage status (ACCEPT, AT RISK w/reason, or BLOCKED + owner):

- Stage: Contract signed / Docs in DocuSign
  - Owner: Ben
- Stage: PO received / Billing trigger
  - Owner: Monica
- Stage: Legal redlines cleared
  - Owner: Laura
- Stage: Technical ok / onboarding schedule confirmed
  - Owner: Sergio

Immediate asks:
1) Attach latest commit spreadsheet to your reply (sheet named by account). I attached a blank template in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-QuarterClose-Playbook
2) If the accounting milestone will slip, flag the dollar impact (ARR or one-time) and earliest possible close date.
3) Any external billing dependencies (customer PO, procurement, internal finance approvals) — call them out.

I put Acme Analytics on a short runway — they told us they need invoice timing confirmed by Thursday morning. If we can confirm PO then we can include in the rollup.

Attachment: [attachment: commit-rollup-20270928.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Thanks — quick replies appreciated.

Sergio

Quick notes:
- If Priya sends the PO before 11:00 PT tomorrow, finance can include Acme in the Thursday rollup.
- If not, we should mark as "Late in quarter" and include as a carryover in Friday's reconciliation.
